title: Blackstone offers to sell up to 25% of India's Knowledge REIT for over $1 billion
summary: Blackstone is looking to sell a stake of up to 25.03 percent in Knowledge Realty Trust. This offer encompasses both a base stake and an oversubscription option. The base price has been established at 108 rupees per unit. Knowledge Realty Trust, supported by Blackstone and Sattva Group, manages a diverse portfolio of assets. Since its listing in August 2025, the REIT has experienced moderate growth

title: GST Council to hold 57th meet on Sept 12
summary: The GST Council will meet on September 12 to discuss key reforms.  Proposals include easier input tax credit access for buyers and simplified corporate guarantee treatment.  Small businesses may soon register in multiple states for easier compliance.  The meeting aims to address unresolved issues affecting working capital and costs.  This session follows nearly a year after the council's last gath

summary: It had already been a tough 2026 for Acrisure. title: Max Estates buys 85-acre land in Delhi to build projects, eyes Rs 10,000-12,000 cr revenue
summary: Max Estates has successfully acquired 84.71 acres in West Delhi for a whopping Rs 420 crore. This bold move paves the way for future residential and commercial projects, estimated to yield between Rs 10,000 and Rs 12,000 crore in revenue. By entering Delhi's housing market, Max Estates significantly enhances its land portfolio while ensuring robust future growth without immediate cash expenditure.

title: Gujarat aims to catch US shrimp orders with turtle-safe nets
summary: Gujarat will install turtle excluder devices in fishermen's nets. This initiative aims to boost seafood exports to the United States and global markets. The government will provide these devices free of cost to 8,925 fishermen. This project will protect marine biodiversity and create new opportunities. The devices allow shrimp retention while turtles escape fishing nets.
